pages.text: Use a Connector to attach a cable network to a block or machine. Open the Connector to name it and control whether it is enabled.
Advanced Connectors support higher internal energy capacity and more demanding setups. They are configured in the same way as normal connectors.

Place a Routing Connector directly against each Router or Wireless Router on the routing network. Join them with Routing Network Cable. Use a colored Connector where a Controller's local network meets a Router.
